text: dsh-svw-waveform 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的波形查看插件：它注册 svw_wave_render 工具，并把返回内容呈现在终端卡片或交互式网页波形视图中。用户可指定 VCD/FST 文件、时间范围和层级信号，查看彩色时序轨迹，并在网页中缩放、平移、放置标记、切换数值进制和查找边沿。适合需要在 DSH 中检查数字电路仿真波形的开发者。需要本机可用的 SVW 程序；可用 SVW_BIN 指定路径。

dsh-svw-waveform adds svw_wave_render to DeepSeek Harness Web. Specify a VCD/FST file, time range, and hierarchical signals to render colored traces. The browser view supports zoom, pan, markers, radix switching, and edge search. A local SVW executable is required; SVW_BIN can set its path.
想在 DSH 里直接查看 VCD 仿真波形。
能不能把指定信号的一段时序画出来，方便我检查？
I want to inspect selected signals from an FST waveform in my DSH web session.
dsh-svw-waveform 的功能「波形渲染」：通过 svw_wave_render 指定 VCD/FST 文件、起止时间和 1 至 12 个层级信号，返回彩色终端波形及信号变化摘要。
dsh-svw-waveform 的功能「交互式查看」：网页客户端把工具结果画成波形视图，可缩放、平移、放置时间标记、切换数值进制并跳转信号边沿。

dsh-svw-waveform README · dsh-svw-waveform：Native [SVW](https://github.com/svcomplex-dev/svw) waveform rendering for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

dsh-svw-waveform README · dsh-svw-waveform：The plugin registers `svw_wave_render`. The model supplies an exact VCD or FST
path, native tick range, and one to twelve hierarchical signal names. In the
DeepSeek Harness Web UI the result becomes an interactive waveform viewer with
zoom, pan, markers, radix selection, edge navigation, and delta-cycle markers.
Surfaces without the client plugin fall back to the complete ANSI terminal
waveform card.

dsh-svw-waveform README · Install：Install the public npm bundle into the Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-svw-waveform
dsh --profile web --dump-config
dsh --profile web
```

dsh-svw-waveform README · Install：The npm bundle selects a package-private SVW executable for Linux x64 or macOS
arm64. It does not compile on the consumer machine and has no `install`,
`postinstall`, or `prepare` script. Set `SVW_BIN=/absolute/path/to/svw` to use
an independently installed binary instead. On macOS, an existing Homebrew SVW
installation is also accepted as a fallback.

dsh-svw-waveform README · Install：DeepSeek Harness is still a developer preview. This package currently supports
the `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.x release-candidate line and tests every change
against a pinned version before publication.

dsh-svw-waveform README · Use：First obtain exact signal names:

```sh
svw agent design.vcd signals reset 20
```

Then ask the agent to display a bounded window, or call the registered tool
with arguments equivalent to:

```json
{
  "waveform": "design.vcd",
  "start": 100,
  "end": 160,

The bundled `svw-waveform` skill teaches the agent the complete discovery,
value/change, render, comparison, semantic-design, UVM, and coverage workflows.

dsh-svw-waveform README · Artifact provenance：SVW GitHub Releases are the only binary source. This repository never rebuilds
SVW. Its release workflow:

dsh-svw-waveform README · Artifact provenance：- `dsh-svw-waveform-linux-x64`
- `dsh-svw-waveform-darwin-arm64`

Each package includes `svw-provenance.json` with the source Release asset and
both archive and binary SHA256 values. Replacing an asset under the same SVW
tag creates a new immutable plugin patch version rather than overwriting an npm
version.

dsh-svw-waveform README · Artifact provenance：The host and browser integration are synchronized from the versioned
`share/svw/agents/dsh-extension` files inside the same verified SVW archive.
`svw-source.json` records their original hashes and the small downstream
packaging transforms.

dsh-svw-waveform README · Publishing setup：The `publish.yml` workflow accepts either `repository_dispatch` event
`svw-release-published` or a manual `release-X.Y.Z` input. It supports a
temporary `NPM_TOKEN` for bootstrapping the three package names. After that,
configure npm Trusted Publishing for each package with:

- GitHub organization: `svcomplex-dev`
- repository: `dsh-svw-waveform`
- workflow filename: `publish.yml`
- allowed action: `npm publish`

dsh-svw-waveform README · Publishing setup：Once all three trusted publishers work, remove `NPM_TOKEN`. The workflow uses
GitHub OIDC and publishes npm provenance automatically.

dsh-svw-waveform README · Development：```sh
npm run verify
sh scripts/setup-git-hooks.sh
```

All commits and annotated package tags must use
`svcomplex-dev <code@svcomplex.ai>`.
